text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh... All I wanted was a happy 
wedding...! 
So why did it have to turn out like 
this...?!"

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
"N-No! Stop it already!!  
...—KYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"—...I make this vow. The only one who can 
make me happy is myself. 
Therefore, the one who claims you... shall 
also be me."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"What a marvelous proposal...! The final 
'Muse' for the 'Beauty Dream Cup' is 
decided, and it's you, Gentil-chan...!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, the final 'Muse'! 
Does that mean—"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, this year's 'BDC' Muses are the five 
of you! 
I'm going to design custom racewear just 
for you all!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Aren't you excited? Gentildonna-chan, 
Manhattan Cafe-chan. 
Along with Gran Alegria-chan—"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Satono Diamond-chan and Blast 
Onepiece-chan! 
You are the Muses! The beautifully radiant 
Muses of this year!"
Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: This Year's Muses
text_block_list.text: A photoshoot in our racewear?!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"That's right! The 'Beauty Dream Cup' 
you'll be running in is the debut race for 
the racewear I design!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"That's why we need a key visual... a 
'photo'! 
A jaw-dropping, absolutely spectacular 
photo for posters and the website!!"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, we have to be picky about the 
location, too! I've put together a 
sparkling list of candidates♡ So please, 
pick a truly trèèès bien spot together, 
okay?♪"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"She said anywhere from a beach to a train 
station is fair game! 
...As the Mile Queen, maybe Hanshin 
Racecourse is a must-have!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"My, look at all the sticky notes packed 
onto that list...! 
Gran-san, have you decided on your top 
choice?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Not yet! My rule for this is 'pick the 
place that feels like destiny'! 
It's an important photoshoot, so I want to 
prioritize that spark of excitement♪"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, having criteria is important. As a 
Satono Umamusume... 
I must take a photo that repays everyone 
who has placed their trust in me."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Therefore, I would love to shoot at a 
chapel, which everyone dreams of! 
Blast-san, what about you?"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"I really like this one over here! 
It says it's a 'flower garden' that's 
super popular with people!"

text_block_list.name: Gran & Dia
text_block_list.text:
"—! So cute...! 
—! How lovely...~"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"The photo's gonna be shown to people all 
over the world, right? 
Then it should be somewhere that spreads 
'happiness'!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Bu wants to show everyone who's supported 
and cheered for me how happy I am, and 
make them smile a whole bunch!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Oh my. 
In that case, the ladies in their racewear 
will—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Swaying their veils beneath a chandelier 
would be utterly charming too, wouldn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...What should I do? Everything is making 
my heart race so far! 
Is the photoshoot really this weekend? 
Ahhh, what are we going to do?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu... Yeah, everyone is so excited. 
So much so that we can't even pick a 
single place... ......

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You're right, I'm looking forward to it 
too... 
You're smiling, too... I want to preserve 
this moment forever.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...They tailored a racewear outfit for me, 
too. 
An outfit fitting for a night where the 
lights all melt together—...?...?

(Rustle rustle rustle! 
Flap-flap-flap-flap!!)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
What's with this crazy wind?! 
Did someone leave the window—huh? It's 
closed...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Hey, hey, look at this! 
Everyone, please look at this!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
It's so gorgeous... I just got total 
sparks from it...! 
What do you think of this place...?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And look, look, there's even a chandelier 
in the grand hall! 
Could it be a manor complete with a chapel 
and guest lodgings?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Even a balcony. 
Oho... How romantic.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I love it...! This place is awesome! It's 
packed with everyone's "happiness"! 
It looks like the kind of place where we 
can take the "happiest" photos ever!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I vote for this one too! It's 200 miles of 
perfection!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Then let's book it for the shoot! 
Are you okay with that too, Cafe-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
From what I can see... it looks like a 
calm and peaceful place. 
The atmosphere... seems lovely as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—Alright everyone, allow me to announce 
our schedule starting today! 
Today, we will be arriving ahead of time 
for the photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Beauty-san and the rest of the crew will 
arrive tomorrow! 
Which means the real shoot is tomorrow. 
Until then, we will—

text_block_list.name: Dia & Gran
text_block_list.text: Work hard on cleaning it up!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Apparently they said, "You can use it, but 
no one's cleaned it in a while"! 
Fufufu... We're gonna make it sparkly and 
squeaky clean!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
An overnight cleaning party! 
While scouting the location, let's find 
all the best spots!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
And for that, first we need fuel! 
Any Umamusume who wants popcorn, raise 
your hand!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Mee!" 
"Dietary fiber and polyphenols. It should 
make for a fine snack."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, did you tell me about that place? 
Because everyone was having trouble 
deciding, did you—...?

C o me. H a ppy. C o me. B r eak. P l ay. 
A f e ast. 
B r eak
I   H A T E   Y O U

text_block_list.name: ▼↑?! G△■gaaah
text_block_list.text:
"A H A   H A   H A     H A A   HAHA ! ! ! 
!"
(BANG--!!)

text_block_list.name: Driver
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry, ladies! 
There's been a breakdown... I will pull 
over to the side!
